scope: 24 cases of the actual current renderer and nine real option sets. Card width 278px is reproduced. Original regression, fixed page/grid/button-content overflow, unchanged desktop geometry and label/selection/radius parity, central minimum 110 to 160 and CSS gap/radius mutations. Product persistence and all network requests are disabled.
